definition: A candidate is evaluated against its first addition to the frozen Nanochat roster, never against a later repository upload date.

route_basis.semantics: logical_acquisition_type selects the source_routes and review_routes error model. Observed extraction exceptions are representation-specific secondary diagnostics only; they never replace the logical source route.

diavgeia.rationale: Diavgeia decisions are governance records that can combine rendered service-page content with attached decision documents, so neither web-template nor PDF-extraction defects may be discarded.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: Rendered decision pages or markdown conversions can retain navigation, signature boilerplate, and page-template text.
An attached decision can be a born-digital or scanned PDF with text-extraction/OCR defects.

amna_press.rationale: The selected AMNA representation is an article-web corpus with markdown and cleaned web-text fields, making page-template and syndication defects primary.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: A release or attachment reproduced through an article page can still originate from a PDF and exhibit OCR-like loss.

ellakv2.rationale: EELLAK V2 is evaluated as a web-article corpus; replayed templates, navigation, and copied article furniture are its primary error model.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: An article can embed or reproduce a PDF-originated publication, which warrants secondary OCR checks without changing its logical web route.

psepheda.rationale: Psepheda records are document-repository material keyed by handle and PDF URLs, so PDF/text-extraction integrity is primary rather than the repository landing page.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: Repository landing-page or embedded HTML fragments can introduce metadata, navigation, or template residue in a PDF-derived record.

elocus.rationale: eLocus is handled as a repository-document corpus with URL and PDF identity, so document extraction is the logical source of text quality errors.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: Catalog or item-page text may be retained alongside a PDF-derived body and should trigger secondary web-template diagnostics.

libduth.rationale: The DUTH library material is identified through repository and PDF URLs and is assessed as document extraction, not as a native web-article corpus.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: Repository shells or item metadata can surface in an extracted representation and add secondary HTML/template risks.

libiep.rationale: The IEP material is repository and educational-document content with historical-OCR handling, making page-level extraction defects primary.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: A repository index or viewer can contribute HTML metadata or template text around a PDF-derived work.

ecclesia.rationale: Ecclesia is a historical serial/document corpus, so issue scans and their OCR or page-furniture effects are the primary quality model.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: Issue indexes or archive pages can add site chrome or repeated metadata to a serial-derived text representation.

opengov_deliberations_v2.rationale: OpenGov V2 combines native consultation articles/comments with submitted documents, so structured parent-context and PDF/HTML representation defects must both be considered.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: Nested articles, comments, and documents can repeat consultation context or flatten fields incorrectly.
Consultation-page markup and navigation can survive in rendered article text.
Submitted or linked documents can contribute PDF extraction and OCR artifacts.

archetai.rationale: Archetai is treated as an archival/academic document collection, so extraction completeness and OCR quality of the works are primary.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: Archive search and item pages can leak catalog/template text into a document-derived representation.

eellak_articles.rationale: EELLAK Articles is a web-article source, so site boilerplate, article replay, and template concentration are the logical primary risks.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: A linked or copied publication can be PDF-derived and deserves secondary extraction-quality checks.

open_council.rationale: OpenCouncil supplies a selected full-transcript field from meeting records, so field flattening and repeated meeting context are primary rather than web-page extraction.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: A rendered transcript page can carry navigation, widgets, or page furniture around the native transcript.
Agenda or attachment text associated with a meeting can be PDF-derived and should receive secondary OCR diagnostics.

artos_zois.rationale: Artos Zois is an issue-level historical serial collection; page scans, OCR, and issue furniture are the logical primary error model.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: Journal indexes or issue landing pages can introduce secondary web-template material.

e_nautilia.rationale: E-Nautilia is a technical-document/textbook source with PDF identity, so tables, formulas, and PDF extraction fidelity are primary.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: Catalog or viewer pages may add HTML metadata or navigation around an otherwise PDF-derived technical work.

national_theatre_press.rationale: The National Theatre corpus is historical press material with an OCR-focused cleaning profile, so scan quality, mastheads, and page furniture are primary.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: Press-archive pages can contribute archive metadata or navigation to a historical-page extraction.

heinrich_boell_publications.rationale: Heinrich Böll publications are report/document material with a PDF-report OCR profile, making document extraction and publication furniture primary.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: Publication landing pages can add HTML description or template text around a PDF-derived report.

new_sociology.rationale: New Sociology is an issue-level historical serial corpus, so article segmentation, OCR, and issue-level page furniture are primary.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: Journal or issue index pages can surface secondary HTML metadata and repeated site furniture.

school_books_new_editions.rationale: The new school-book editions span multiple text schemas and work/edition representations, including textbook document extraction, so neither structured-schema nor PDF-quality risks alone are sufficient.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: Edition metadata and distinct plain-text/text-content schemas can cause field-selection or inherited-context errors.
A textbook representation can retain PDF/OCR defects such as headers, hyphenation, tables, or formula loss.

openbook_v2.rationale: OpenBook V2 is a replacement book extraction identified by book and PDF URLs, so book/PDF extraction quality remains primary despite its web catalog.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: Book catalog pages can contribute descriptions, navigation, or template content to a PDF-derived representation.

pergamos_sections.rationale: Pergamos section rows are a resegmented transport form of repository works; the logical text origin remains the academic document/PDF extraction.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: Section boundaries or inherited repository fields can repeat parent context or split headings from body text.
Repository record-page metadata can appear around the extracted academic work.

kallipos_sections.rationale: Kallipos section rows are a resegmented transport form of academic books; their logical source remains document/PDF extraction rather than the section table alone.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: Section serialization can repeat book-level context or introduce field-boundary and ordering artifacts.
Repository or book landing-page metadata can survive beside a PDF-derived section.

greek_phd_v2.rationale: Greek PhD V2 uses an extracted-markdown thesis representation with handle/DOI/URL identity, so thesis PDF extraction and OCR behavior are primary.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: Handle or repository-page metadata can appear in an extracted thesis representation.
A reprocessed thesis record can expose representation or metadata-field artifacts separate from its PDF body.

openarchives_current.rationale: OpenArchives Current is a reprocessed repository-work corpus; despite regenerated shards, its logical text quality is driven by the underlying academic-document/PDF extraction.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: Archive record pages can add catalog or navigation material to a document-derived text.
Regenerated shards or repository metadata can create secondary field/representation artifacts.

istorima.rationale: Istorima supplies oral-history records through a dedicated transcription field, so transcript schema, speaker/context repetition, and record flattening are primary.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: A rendered oral-history page can retain labels, navigation, or HTML markup around the native transcript.

modern_greek_dictionary.rationale: The dictionary is selected as lexical entries with entry text, lemma, and source URL, so entry schema and repeated lexical-template behavior are primary rather than prose-page extraction.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: Source-page markup, navigation, or HTML entry decorations can survive in a structured lexical record.

ert_press.rationale: ERT Press is a news/article web source, so article furniture, web markup, and news replay are its primary extraction-risk model.

expected_observed_extraction_exceptions.rationale: A press item can embed or reproduce a PDF-originated release and therefore warrant secondary OCR checks.

route_policy.html_web: Prioritize HTML scrape/template/navigation/markup diagnostics; retain PDF/OCR checks only when a documented representation exhibits them.
route_policy.pdf_ocr: Prioritize PDF/OCR/text-extraction diagnostics even when the resulting text was posted on a web page.
route_policy.mixed: Run both logical HTML/structured-context and PDF/OCR extraction diagnostics; do not collapse to structured solely because metadata is JSON.
route_policy.structured: Prioritize schema completeness, field flattening, and repeated parent/context template diagnostics.

review_scope: Every listed source with full text or replacement content is reviewed; a source with fewer than 100 eligible documents is exhaustively reviewed and carries an explicit denominator exception.
